name: espurna-core
description: ESPurna's own Arduino API layer: String, Print, Stream, IPAddress of ArduinoCore-API 2022.08.24 (src/arduino-api, unchanged copy) plus time, GPIO, Serial, Wire and SPI on the chip SDK. One layer for ESP8266, ESP32 and Beken, builds without the Arduino framework; the sensor libraries build on it unchanged
